The name Imtayaz carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Imtayaz usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
